inlines.text: H3 Family

blocks.text: Openness is what turns a technology into an ecosystem. A handful of gifted people can invent a technology or build a tool. Only when people share what they've built and work together as a network can creativity flourish and change the way we live.

inlines.text: Openness is what turns a technology into an ecosystem. A handful of gifted people can invent a technology or build a tool. Only when people share what they've built and work together as a network can creativity flourish and change the way we live.

blocks.text: AI ecosystems start with open source. In the 100 days since we open-sourced MiniMax H3, developers have turned one H3 into 1,472 derivative models for 1,472 distinct needs and uses. Together, these models have been downloaded more than 148 million times, an average of over 17 downloads a second. New derivatives continue to appear.

inlines.text: AI ecosystems start with open source.

In the 100 days since we open-sourced MiniMax H3, developers have turned one H3 into 1,472 derivative models for 1,472 distinct needs and uses. Together, these models have been downloaded more than 148 million times, an average of over 17 downloads a second.
New derivatives continue to appear.

blocks.text: H3 has given enthusiasts, developers, and companies a common starting point. Leading technology companies such as NVIDIA, Tencent, and Alibaba have trained their own versions of H3 for different purposes. So have AI application and platform leaders including fal, Suno, HeyGen, Pika, and Creatify, and research teams at MIT, the National University of Singapore, and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. More than ten leading companies worldwide now have licensing partnerships with MiniMax. They're using H3 to strengthen production workflows in e-commerce, gaming, film and TV, animation and comics, short-form dramas, industrial design, and other fields.

blocks.text: Today we're introducing the H3 Family, which includes the flagship H3 and H3-Image series and a range of extended models. The flagship models and some of the extended models are available directly through the MiniMax Open Platform, MiniMax Code, and other platforms.

blocks.text: You can tell H3 what you wish a scene would feel like, even when the idea is still hazy. It understands minimalist chic in an ad, a sense of mystery and fate in a film, or a traditional Chinese aesthetic in animation. It picks up on the difference between a character who is angry, one who feels wronged, and one who can't accept how things turned out. It can carry the story forward in a way that fits the characters and render it at up to 2K.

blocks.text: H3 also follows instructions closely through a series of precise edits. You can replace a person, an item of clothing, or an object, or change the light and shadow in one part of a shot. The rest of the frame stays intact as you continue to refine it.

inlines.text: MiniMax H3-Highspeed

blocks.text: A first choice for everyday commercial work and large-scale production

inlines.text: A first choice for everyday commercial work and large-scale production

blocks.text: 768P or 480P output, starting at $0.04 per second

inlines.text: 768P or 480P output, starting at $0.04 per second

blocks.text: H3-Highspeed balances speed and cost with the quality and reliability that daily production demands. A five-second clip takes about 11 seconds to generate on average. For clips up to 15 seconds long, it takes no more than a minute to go from prompt to finished video. The model supports clips up to 30 seconds long.

blocks.text: We worked with our partners to bring down inference costs. Teams in e-commerce, gaming, motion graphics, and live-action advertising often need a steady supply of material in large volumes. H3-Highspeed produces it in batches at a lower cost while maintaining quality. It's like having a colleague you can count on in your day-to-day work.

blocks.text: H3-Lite's speed and low cost make it easier to work efficiently. Early in a project, you can test several ideas, compare the results, and choose a direction while spending less time and money. It's also well suited to producing repetitive commercial material in volume, such as dozens of ads showing the same product in different settings, or different characters acting out similar storylines.

blocks.text: Fast generation, high image quality and close adherence to instructions

blocks.text: Image output costs $3.80 per million tokens

blocks.text: H3-Image produces high-quality images with rich detail and a realistic look. It follows instructions more closely than any other open-source model and supports up to 16 reference images. It also offers good value, generating images at 150% to 200% of the speed of mainstream models for 50% to 70% of the price.

blocks.text: We'll continue to welcome H3-based derivative models into the H3 Family. The partnership is open to developers and companies around the world. If you have a new idea for video generation in AI avatars, film and TV, e-commerce, gaming, or another field, we invite you to build a custom model on H3. You can also take part in the H3 community by sharing your ideas and needs in our discussion groups or through other channels.
